examples.en: "And" and "but" are common examples of a conjunction.
examples.zh: 「and」和「but」是連接詞的常見例子。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to circle each conjunction in the sentence.
examples.zh: 老師要我們把句子裡的每個連接詞圈起來。

examples.en: The festival was held in conjunction with the school's anniversary.
examples.zh: 這場活動與學校的校慶一起舉辦。

senses.zh: 脆的；酥脆的；清爽的；乾脆俐落的

examples.en: I love the crisp skin on roast chicken.
examples.zh: 我喜歡烤雞那層酥脆的皮。

examples.en: The air was crisp and cold on the autumn morning.
examples.zh: 秋天的早晨，空氣清爽又寒冷。

examples.en: She gave a crisp answer to every question.
examples.zh: 她對每個問題都回答得很乾脆。

examples.en: He bought a bag of crisps at the kiosk.
examples.zh: 他在小販亭買了一包洋芋片。

examples.en: The kids ate crisps while watching the movie.
examples.zh: 孩子們邊看電影邊吃洋芋片。

examples.en: Do you want some crisps with your sandwich?
examples.zh: 你的三明治要配一些洋芋片嗎？

senses.zh: 十字路口；交叉口；轉捩點

examples.en: Turn left when you reach the crossroad.
examples.zh: 走到十字路口時請左轉。

examples.en: A small shop stands at the crossroad near my house.
examples.zh: 我家附近的十字路口有一間小店。

examples.en: She felt she was at a crossroads in her career.
examples.zh: 她覺得自己的職涯正處於轉捩點。

senses.zh: 騎自行車的人；單車騎士

examples.en: The cyclist stopped at the red light.
examples.zh: 那位單車騎士在紅燈前停了下來。

examples.en: Cyclists should always wear a helmet for safety.
examples.zh: 單車騎士為了安全，應該隨時戴安全帽。

examples.en: My uncle is a serious cyclist and rides every weekend.
examples.zh: 我叔叔是個認真的單車騎士，每個週末都會騎車。

examples.en: Damn, I left my keys at home again.
examples.zh: 可惡，我又把鑰匙忘在家裡了。

examples.en: Oh damn, the bus just left without us.
examples.zh: 糟了，公車剛剛沒等我們就開走了。

examples.en: Damn, we missed the last train back to town.
examples.zh: 可惡，我們錯過了回鎮上的最後一班火車。

examples.en: This damn printer is jammed again, so I cannot print the report.
examples.zh: 這台該死的印表機又卡紙了，所以我無法列印報告。

examples.en: I can't find my damn phone anywhere.
examples.zh: 我到處都找不到我那支該死的手機。

examples.en: The damn alarm didn't ring this morning.
examples.zh: 那個該死的鬧鐘今天早上沒響。

examples.en: The room is full of daylight in the morning.
examples.zh: 房間早上充滿了日光。

examples.en: We hope to reach the village before daylight fades.
examples.zh: 我們希望在天黑前抵達村莊。

examples.en: The thief was caught in broad daylight.
examples.zh: 小偷在光天化日之下被抓到。

examples.en: Please delete the old files from your computer.
examples.zh: 請把電腦裡的舊檔案刪除。

examples.en: I accidentally deleted the photo I wanted to keep.
examples.zh: 我不小心把想留著的照片刪掉了。

examples.en: You can delete a message by pressing this button.
examples.zh: 按這個按鈕就能刪除訊息。

senses.zh: 要求高的；費力的；苛求的

examples.en: She has a very demanding job in a busy hospital.
examples.zh: 她在一間繁忙的醫院裡從事一份要求很高的工作。

examples.en: Our math teacher is strict and demanding.
examples.zh: 我們的數學老師嚴格又要求很高。

examples.en: Taking care of a baby can be physically demanding.
examples.zh: 照顧嬰兒可能相當耗費體力。

examples.en: Tom is a dependable friend who always helps us.
examples.zh: 湯姆是個可靠的朋友，總是幫助我們。

examples.en: We need a dependable car for the long trip.
examples.zh: 我們需要一輛可靠的車來進行這趟長途旅行。

examples.en: The company is looking for a dependable assistant.
examples.zh: 公司正在找一位值得信賴的助理。

examples.en: The guide gave us a detailed map of the city.
examples.zh: 導遊給了我們一張詳細的市區地圖。

examples.en: Please send me a detailed report by Friday.
examples.zh: 請在週五前寄給我一份詳細的報告。

examples.en: The artist made a detailed drawing of the old temple.
examples.zh: 那位藝術家畫了一幅古廟的精細畫作。

examples.en: The development of the new park took two years.
examples.zh: 這座新公園的開發花了兩年。

examples.en: Exercise is important for a child's healthy development.
examples.zh: 運動對孩子的健康成長很重要。

examples.en: We will tell you about any new development in the case.
examples.zh: 案件若有任何新情況，我們會通知你。

senses.zh: 盡心盡力的；忠誠的；全心投入的

examples.en: She is a devoted mother of three children.
examples.zh: 她是一位對三個孩子盡心盡力的母親。

examples.en: The dog was devoted to its owner.
examples.zh: 這隻狗對牠的主人非常忠誠。

examples.en: He is devoted to his work as a teacher.
examples.zh: 他全心投入教師這份工作。

examples.en: The students practiced a short dialog in English class.
examples.zh: 學生們在英文課練習了一段簡短的對話。

examples.en: A dialog box appeared on the screen.
examples.zh: 螢幕上跳出了一個對話框。

examples.en: The two leaders held a friendly dialog about trade.
examples.zh: 兩位領導人就貿易進行了友善的對談。

examples.en: A mobile phone number in Taiwan usually has ten digits.
examples.zh: 台灣的手機號碼通常有十位數。

examples.en: Please enter the last digit of your phone number.
examples.zh: 請輸入你電話號碼的最後一個數字。

examples.en: Each digit of the code must be correct.
examples.zh: 密碼中的每個數字都必須正確。

examples.en: The new station has an elevator for disabled passengers.
examples.zh: 新車站為身心障礙的乘客設有電梯。

examples.en: The alarm was disabled during the repair work.
examples.zh: 維修期間，警報器被停用了。

examples.en: This seat is for people who are disabled.
examples.zh: 這個座位是給身心障礙者坐的。

senses.zh: 弱勢的；處於不利地位的

examples.en: The charity helps disadvantaged children go to school.
examples.zh: 這個慈善團體協助弱勢兒童上學。

examples.en: Students from disadvantaged families can apply for aid.
examples.zh: 來自弱勢家庭的學生可以申請補助。

examples.en: She worked hard to support disadvantaged groups in her town.
examples.zh: 她努力幫助家鄉的弱勢族群。

senses.zh: 失望；令人失望的人或事

examples.en: He could not hide his disappointment when he lost.
examples.zh: 他輸了之後，無法掩飾自己的失望。

examples.en: The movie was a big disappointment to us.
examples.zh: 這部電影讓我們非常失望。

examples.en: To my disappointment, the store was already closed.
examples.zh: 令我失望的是，那家店已經關門了。

examples.en: She shook her head in disapproval when she heard the plan.
examples.zh: 她聽到這項計畫時搖頭表示不贊成。

examples.en: Her parents showed their disapproval of the plan.
examples.zh: 她的父母對這項計畫表示反對。

examples.en: The mayor's decision met with public disapproval.
examples.zh: 市長的決定遭到大眾的反對。

examples.en: Many customers expressed dissatisfaction with the service.
examples.zh: 許多顧客對服務表示不滿。

examples.en: His dissatisfaction with the job made him look for a new one.
examples.zh: 他對工作不滿，所以開始找新工作。

examples.en: There is growing dissatisfaction among the students.
examples.zh: 學生之間的不滿情緒越來越高。

examples.en: There was a lot of distrust between the two teams.
examples.zh: 這兩支隊伍之間有很深的不信任。

examples.en: Her distrust of strangers kept her safe.
examples.zh: 她對陌生人的戒心讓她保持安全。

examples.en: The scandal caused public distrust of the company.
examples.zh: 這起醜聞引起大眾對該公司的不信任。

examples.en: I distrust people who never tell the truth.
examples.zh: 我不信任從不說實話的人。

examples.en: Many shoppers distrust online reviews that offer only praise.
examples.zh: 許多購物者不信任那些只有讚美的網路評論。

examples.en: He began to distrust his partner after the mistake.
examples.zh: 出錯之後，他開始不信任他的夥伴。

examples.en: Are you dressed yet? We have to leave now.
examples.zh: 你衣服穿好了嗎？我們現在得出門了。

examples.en: She was dressed in a long red coat.
examples.zh: 她穿著一件紅色長大衣。

examples.en: The kids were dressed up as animals for the party.
examples.zh: 孩子們穿著動物裝扮去參加派對。

examples.en: A duckling followed its mother across the pond.
examples.zh: 一隻小鴨跟著媽媽游過池塘。

examples.en: The farmer raised a few ducklings in the yard.
examples.zh: 農夫在院子裡養了幾隻小鴨。

examples.en: The little duckling was covered in soft yellow feathers.
examples.zh: 那隻小鴨身上覆蓋著柔軟的黃色羽毛。

examples.en: Her monthly earnings are not high, but she saves a lot.
examples.zh: 她每月的收入不高，但存了很多錢。

examples.en: The company reported strong earnings this year.
examples.zh: 這家公司今年公布了亮眼的盈餘。

examples.en: He spends most of his earnings on books.
examples.zh: 他把大部分收入花在買書上。

examples.en: It is hard to find employment in a small town.
examples.zh: 在小鎮上很難找到工作。

examples.en: The company offers full-time employment to new graduates.
examples.zh: 這家公司提供應屆畢業生全職工作。

examples.en: Please fill in your employment history on the form.
examples.zh: 請在表格上填寫你的工作經歷。

examples.en: Thank you for your encouragement during the exam.
examples.zh: 謝謝你在考試期間的鼓勵。

examples.en: The coach gave the team words of encouragement.
examples.zh: 教練對全隊說了鼓勵的話。

examples.en: With her teacher's encouragement, she joined the contest.
examples.zh: 在老師的鼓勵下，她參加了比賽。

examples.en: Reading novels gives me great enjoyment after a busy day.
examples.zh: 忙碌一天後，閱讀小說帶給我很大的樂趣。

examples.en: The children shouted with enjoyment on the swings.
examples.zh: 孩子們在鞦韆上開心地大叫。

examples.en: She did the volunteer work for her own enjoyment.
examples.zh: 她做志工是為了自己的樂趣。

examples.en: The enlargement of the photo took only a few minutes.
examples.zh: 照片的放大只花了幾分鐘。

examples.en: The city plans an enlargement of the airport.
examples.zh: 市政府計畫擴建機場。

examples.en: She hung an enlargement of the picture on the wall.
examples.zh: 她把那張照片的放大版掛在牆上。

examples.en: The famous entertainer sang at the school festival.
examples.zh: 那位知名藝人在學校園遊會上唱歌。

examples.en: Street entertainers filled the square with music.
examples.zh: 街頭表演者讓廣場充滿了音樂。

examples.en: He dreams of becoming a TV entertainer.
examples.zh: 他夢想成為電視藝人。

examples.en: Movies are my favorite form of entertainment.
examples.zh: 電影是我最喜愛的娛樂方式。

examples.en: The hotel offers live entertainment every night.
examples.zh: 這間旅館每晚都有現場娛樂表演。

examples.en: The entertainment industry employs many young people.
examples.zh: 娛樂產業雇用了許多年輕人。

examples.en: The gym has new exercise equipment for its members.
examples.zh: 這間健身房有供會員使用的新運動器材。

examples.en: We checked all the camera equipment before the trip.
examples.zh: 出發旅行前，我們檢查了所有相機設備。

examples.en: The school bought some science equipment for the lab.
examples.zh: 學校為實驗室買了一些科學器材。

examples.en: The two plans are essentially the same.
examples.zh: 這兩個計畫基本上是一樣的。

examples.en: He is essentially a shy person, despite his confident appearance.
examples.zh: 儘管他看起來很有自信，但本質上是個害羞的人。

examples.en: The report is essentially finished, but a few details need checking.
examples.zh: 這份報告大致上完成了，但還有幾個細節需要檢查。

examples.en: This bag is strong enough for everyday use.
examples.zh: 這個包包夠堅固，可以日常使用。

examples.en: We learned some everyday English phrases in class.
examples.zh: 我們在課堂上學了一些日常英語用語。

examples.en: Traffic jams are part of everyday life in the city.
examples.zh: 塞車是都市日常生活的一部分。

examples.en: The train arrives at exactly nine o'clock.
examples.zh: 火車正好在九點整抵達。

examples.en: That is exactly what I wanted to say.
examples.zh: 那正是我想說的。

examples.en: "Exactly!" the teacher said with a smile.
examples.zh: 「沒錯！」老師笑著說。

examples.en: The kids jumped up and down with excitement.
examples.zh: 孩子們興奮得又蹦又跳。

examples.en: There was great excitement before the concert.
examples.zh: 演唱會開始前現場氣氛非常興奮。

examples.en: The trip was full of excitement for the students.
examples.zh: 這趟旅行對學生來說充滿了刺激。

examples.en: Our class went on an excursion to the science museum.
examples.zh: 我們班到科學博物館校外教學。

examples.en: The hotel offers a boat excursion to the island.
examples.zh: 這間旅館提供前往小島的乘船遊覽。

examples.en: They took a day excursion to the mountains.
examples.zh: 他們到山上做了一日遊。

examples.en: The explorer spent years studying the rain forest.
examples.zh: 這位探險家花了好幾年研究雨林。

examples.en: Early explorers sailed across the ocean in wooden ships.
examples.zh: 早期的探險家乘著木船橫渡海洋。

examples.en: My little brother wants to be an explorer when he grows up.
examples.zh: 我弟弟長大後想當探險家。

examples.en: Farming is an important job in this area.
examples.zh: 農業在這個地區是很重要的工作。

examples.en: Her grandparents earned a living by farming.
examples.zh: 她的祖父母靠務農維生。

examples.en: Modern farming uses many kinds of machines.
examples.zh: 現代農業使用許多種機器。

senses.zh: 有缺陷的；故障的；錯誤的

examples.en: The shop replaced my faulty phone for free.
examples.zh: 店家免費換掉了我有瑕疵的手機。

examples.en: A faulty wire caused the lights to go out.
examples.zh: 一條有問題的電線讓燈熄滅了。

examples.en: His faulty reasoning led to the wrong answer.
examples.zh: 他錯誤的推理導致答案有誤。

examples.en: Heavy rain caused flooding in several streets.
examples.zh: 大雨造成好幾條街道淹水。

examples.en: The town suffers from flooding every summer.
examples.zh: 這個小鎮每年夏天都受水患之苦。

examples.en: Flooding closed the road to the mountain village.
examples.zh: 淹水使通往山村的道路封閉了。

examples.en: She wiped the sweat from her forehead.
examples.zh: 她擦掉額頭上的汗水。

examples.en: The nurse put a hand on my forehead to check for a fever.
examples.zh: 護理師把手放在我的額頭上，檢查有沒有發燒。

examples.en: He hit his forehead on the low door.
examples.zh: 他的額頭撞到了低矮的門。

examples.en: No one could foresee the heavy rain that day.
examples.zh: 沒有人能預料到那天會下大雨。

examples.en: Experts foresee a rise in prices next year.
examples.zh: 專家預料明年物價會上漲。

examples.en: I did not foresee any problems with the plan.
examples.zh: 我沒有預見這項計畫會有任何問題。

examples.en: My grandfather is getting more forgetful with age.
examples.zh: 我爺爺隨著年紀增長越來越健忘。

examples.en: I am so forgetful that I often lose my keys.
examples.zh: 我很健忘，常常弄丟鑰匙。

examples.en: My forgetful classmate keeps a list of homework in her notebook.
examples.zh: 我那位健忘的同學會在筆記本上列出作業清單。

examples.en: Please put the milk back in the fridge.
examples.zh: 請把牛奶放回冰箱。

examples.en: There is nothing to eat in the fridge.
examples.zh: 冰箱裡沒有東西可以吃。

examples.en: We bought a new fridge for the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我們為廚房買了一台新冰箱。

examples.en: It was a frosty morning, so we wore thick coats.
examples.zh: 那是個結霜的早晨，所以我們穿了厚外套。

examples.en: The grass was white and frosty when we left the house.
examples.zh: 我們離開屋子時，草地白茫茫地結了一層霜。

examples.en: She gave him a frosty look and walked away.
examples.zh: 她冷冷地看了他一眼就走開了。

examples.en: The lake was frozen all winter, so boats could not cross it.
examples.zh: 這座湖整個冬天都結著冰，因此船隻無法橫越湖面。

examples.en: I bought some frozen vegetables at the supermarket.
examples.zh: 我在超市買了一些冷凍蔬菜。

examples.en: My hands are frozen after the long walk.
examples.zh: 走了那麼久，我的雙手都凍僵了。

examples.en: She has a full-time job at a bank.
examples.zh: 她在銀行有一份全職工作。

examples.en: He is a full-time student at the university.
examples.zh: 他是這所大學的全時學生。

examples.en: The shop needs two full-time workers to serve its customers.
examples.zh: 這家店需要兩名全職員工來服務顧客。

examples.en: She works full-time at the library near the train station.
examples.zh: 她在火車站附近的圖書館全職工作。

examples.en: My mother studies full-time and works at night.
examples.zh: 我媽媽全時就讀，晚上還要工作。

examples.en: Are you going to teach full-time next year?
examples.zh: 你明年要全職教書嗎？

examples.en: The hotel is fully booked this weekend.
examples.zh: 這間旅館這個週末已經全部訂滿了。

examples.en: I fully understand your concern about the new school rules.
examples.zh: 我完全理解你對新校規的擔憂。

examples.en: The battery is fully charged now and ready for use.
examples.zh: 電池現在已經充飽了，可以使用了。

examples.en: The gambler lost all his money at the casino.
examples.zh: 那名賭徒在賭場輸光了所有的錢。

examples.en: Her uncle was a gambler and often owed money.
examples.zh: 她的叔叔是個賭徒，常常欠錢。

examples.en: A good investor is not a gambler.
examples.zh: 好的投資人不是賭徒。

examples.en: He took his girlfriend to the movies on Saturday.
examples.zh: 他星期六帶女朋友去看電影。

examples.en: My brother's girlfriend is very friendly to everyone she meets.
examples.zh: 我哥哥的女朋友對她遇到的每個人都非常友善。

examples.en: She went shopping with her girlfriend at the department store.
examples.zh: 她和女性友人一起到百貨公司逛街。

examples.en: In the story, the goddess of love helps the young hero.
examples.zh: 在故事裡，愛神幫助了年輕的英雄。

examples.en: The ancient Greeks built a temple for the goddess.
examples.zh: 古希臘人為這位女神蓋了一座神殿。

examples.en: The singer was called a goddess by her fans.
examples.zh: 這位歌手被粉絲稱為女神。
